notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Now, as long as you don't get caught, you will be able to take down enemies with a single hit.

notes.title: 📢 New Update! 📢
notes.notes:
🔧 [b]Latest Fixes and Improvements[/b]
✅ Optimized Memory Usage – DeTechtive 2112 now uses [b]70% less RAM[/b], ensuring a smoother experience.

✅ Reduced VRAM Requirements – Crashes caused by insufficient VRAM have been [b]minimized[/b], improving stability across a wider range of hardware.

✅ Optimized Disk Usage – The game’s file size has been [b]reduced by 35%[/b], requiring less storage space.

✅ Faster Game Startup – The game now [b]launches significantly faster[/b]. The issue causing delays on the main menu screen has been fixed.

✅ Enhanced Enemy AI Positioning – Enemy AI now [b]positions itself more effectively during combat[/b], leading to more dynamic encounters.

✅ Localization Fixes – Various [b]translation and localization errors have been corrected[/b].

✅ Fatal Error Fixes – Multiple [b]Fatal Error crashes have been resolved[/b], enhancing overall stability.

✅ Save Data Cleanup – When starting a new game, [b]previous case data is now properly cleared[/b].



📢 [b]Your Feedback Matters![/b]
We are committed to continuously improving DeTechtive 2112 based on your input. Share your thoughts and let us know what you'd like to see next!

🕵️‍♂️ See you in the field, Detectives!
– The DeTechtive 2112 Team 🚀

notes.title: Patch Notes for February 1
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello DeTechtive 2112 Players![/h1]

Thank you for your interest in our game. Based on your feedback, we continue to improve DeTechtive 2112. Here are the latest updates and improvements:

[h1]Stealth Mechanics Made Easier[/h1]
We have refined the stealth mechanics to make them smoother and more accessible. Sneaking past enemies is now easier than ever!

[h1]AI Vision Adjustments[/h1]
Enemy AI can no longer see behind them, providing a more natural and fair gameplay experience.

[h1]Reworked Map Lighting[/h1]
We’ve adjusted the lighting across maps to better reflect the game’s atmosphere. Environments now look more realistic and immersive.

[h1]Fatal Error on Death Screen Fixed[/h1]
We've fixed the Fatal Error bug that some players encountered on the death screen. You can now enjoy a smoother and uninterrupted experience.

[h1]Boss Balancing[/h1]
To make boss fights more balanced, we’ve made some adjustments. Bosses can no longer be taken down with a single Taser shot, making battles more challenging and rewarding.
